name: Hanshow Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanshow Technology Co., Ltd. provides electronic shelf labeling solutions. It also offers AI monitoring solutions, such as visight cameras, mobile phone app, and spatrol robots that monitor shelves and customer traffic; trolleys with built-in screen and a basket base scale that allows for self-checkout; and All-Star Platform for IoT device management. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Jiaxing, China.
